description:
This is a time series dataset, for 325 different commodities sold across all the mandis/APMC markets across India. Data is avaialble between the date range of **Jan 1st, 2000** to **Feb 1st, 2024**.

Each file has the following columns:
- State Name
- District Name
- Market Name
- Variety
- Group
- Arrivals (Tonnes)
- Min Price (Rs./Quintal)
- Max Price (Rs./Quintal)
- Modal Price (Rs./Quintal)
- Reported Date
provenance_limit: Public publisher's historical market-data release; not independently verified against original daily government reports.
